standard_prerequisites.name: The restriction description of j_p: maps F -> j_pG are compatible families F(V) -> G(V) for V open in U (lemma-j-pullback)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies maps out of j_{p!}F with maps into the restriction, proving (1).

core_obligations: (1) To map j_{p!}F into a presheaf G it is enough to give maps F(V) -> G(V) for every V subset U open, compatible with restrictions (proof lines 4800-4802); by the restriction description of j_p these are exactly maps F -> j_pG (proof lines 4802-4805), so j_{p!} is left adjoint to j_p. (2) The adjointness of j_! and restriction on sheaves follows by applying sheafification to the presheaf-level adjunction (proof lines 4806-4807). (3) The extension by the empty set agrees with F on opens inside U and is empty elsewhere, so by the definition of a stalk its stalks are F_x for x in U and empty outside (proof lines 4808-4811). (4), (5) evaluating j_pj_{p!}F and j^{-1}j_!F on any open of U gives F(V), so the counits are identities (proof lines 4811-4813).
proof_roadmap: Prove the presheaf adjunction (1) by matching compatible families with maps into j_pG (proof lines 4800-4805).
Transport to sheaves by sheafification and read off stalks and counit identities from the definitions (proof lines 4806-4813).
